## Install

```sh
opencode plugin @mirrowel/opencode-agent-variants@dev --global
```

## What's Changed

### Fixes
- fix(attribution): exclude OpenCode's native (@agent subagent) title suffix from annotation parsing (appended on agent-switch resumes after our note - grammatically identical to the terse form, won last-wins and displayed 'general subagent'); attribution ladder reordered to first-party evidence: metadata > validated title annotation > truthful last-leg model inference (per-child bounded probe; the stale session-row model field is never inference input - it confidently mis-attributed explore-heavy) > parent+model; resume guard gains the same fallbacks (child title annotation - zero extra calls, the row is already fetched for task-id validation - then unique-model inference); unknown tokens validated against the live route map everywhere ([`9751bfc`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/opencode-agent-variants/commit/9751bfc8deefcc311a415bdb1d61823e2e529127)) by @Mirrowel

### Documentation
- docs: architecture/structure catch-up (task-id validation, variant-key matching, base-disable, v2 layers) + schema.json regen (taskValidation block) ([`4220624`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/opencode-agent-variants/commit/42206241c35861a2621d6e8211d67d2f8a265f5f)) by @Mirrowel

## What's Changed

### Features
- feat(resume): deliberate cross-variant switch via switch_variant opt-in (never consumed or scrubbed - replay keeps the model's evidence); annotations rewritten terse + parrot-proof - formatVariantNote/stripVariantNotes/parseVariantAnnotation read all historical forms, writers strip the whole parroted stack and append exactly one canonical note, switch notes render (@new <- old); cross-key rejections teach the opt-in; description-parsed attribution validated against the route map ([`df9ba4b`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/opencode-agent-variants/commit/df9ba4bfc6957db2f052bee7c24d1c5b60a5501e)) by @Mirrowel
